divergences.old: checkmarx.clientId and checkmarx.clientSecret, exchanged with the client_credentials grant when no apiKey is set
divergences.toil: API key only. clientId and clientSecret are removed keys (a CONFIG_REMOVED_KEY warning each, saying to set apiKey; the values are dropped, never sent), and a connection without apiKey is CONFIG_INVALID naming apiKey and TOIL_CHECKMARX_API_KEY
divergences.why: Client credentials need an OAuth client registered for the tool, which the Authentication Bar rules out; the API key is a refresh token exchanged over plain HTTP, which it allows (maintainer's decision on #32).

divergences.old: The API key POSTed to whatever host the ast.-to-iam. rewrite of baseUrl produces, over https
divergences.toil: The exchange goes only to a host under checkmarx.net over HTTPS, or to the connection's own origin; anything else is refused with AUTH before the key is sent
divergences.why: A long-lived credential goes only to the host it's configured for or a vendor domain written in the area's code, never to a host derived from a setting (#68 decision 1).

divergences.old: checkmarx project list and scan list writing "warning: N projects found; only showing first M" to stderr when the server counts more than one page
divergences.toil: The same words in meta.warnings, code CHECKMARX_TRUNCATED, and nothing on stderr; data is unchanged
divergences.why: A JSON consumer never sees stderr, so a truncated result has to say so in the envelope it reads. Additive to data.
